safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes Clenil daily but does not document the specific baseline dose of 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs twice daily) reduces the clinician’s ability to judge the magnitude of step-up therapy and assess adherence/overuse, which can affect safe asthma management decisions. It is unlikely to cause direct harm on its own but can contribute to suboptimal dosing and follow-up.
